title: Wall clock versus busy dragons
narrative: Nubble is asked whether parallel agents “sped things up.” Elapsed wall time dropped, but total node work ballooned and queue waits hid under a vanity speedup number. He wants topology metrics that separate critical path, total work, and elapsed time — and that refuse a misleading efficiency claim without a serial baseline and an honest worker-count note. He relates to this whenever ops must explain cost and concurrency without Amdahl fairy tales.
